doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Other Lunceford solos including Blues in the Night
summary: He confirms soloing on Blues in the Night and recalls solos then were only eight to twelve bars.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: So there were some other tunes on that recording, during that, how about Twenty-Four Robbers?
Twenty-Four Robbers…Twenty-Four Robbers. I know there was a solo on there, I was wondering if that was you. Or Blues in the Night?
Did you solo on any of the other recordings during that session?

You played a lot of solos in them bands, but I can‘t recall a lot of tunes, and you only played eight, ten, or twelve bars back in them days because…it was all just on a recording, you didn‘t play, very seldom did you feature the whole thing, I mean, you see what I‘m saying.
